description: Latch is a native macOS menu-bar app that keeps your Mac awake for long-running AI agent and dev jobs — even with the lid closed (Pro) — then lets it sleep automatically when the work is done. It tracks real process activity (CPU/disk, including child processes) instead of guessing with timers, with battery and thermal guardrails, a self-healing watchdog, per-session cost reports, and remote control via Telegram and the latchctl CLI. One-time purchase, no subscription.
